original_ai_output.title_zh: 三角洲州校车司机因涉嫌绑架并强奸14岁学生、收取赎金被捕
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚三角洲州警方逮捕一名28岁校车司机Onome Lucky Ughagha，其被指在Sapele绑架并性侵一名14岁女学生，并向其父亲索要并收取50.3万奈拉赎金。据警方称，嫌疑人取钱后将女孩遗弃在Sapele的Oton路，女孩获救时处于受创状态，有遭性侵迹象。嫌疑人于10月23日在Sapele的Ajimele地区落网，据称初步审讯中已认罪。案件目前为单一来源报道，相关指控尚未经法院证实。

key_facts.fact: 三角洲州警方逮捕28岁校车司机Onome Lucky Ughagha，其涉嫌绑架并性侵一名14岁女学生
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Delta State Police Command has arrested a 28-year-old school bus driver, Onome Lucky Ughagha, for allegedly kidnapping and sexually assaulting a 14-year-old female student in Sapele, Delta State

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人被指向女孩父亲索要并收取50.3万奈拉赎金
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: after demanding and collecting ₦503,000 in ransom from her father

key_facts.fact: 女孩在Oton路被遗弃后与家人团聚，当时处于受创状态并有遭性侵迹象
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the victim was reportedly abandoned along Oton Road, Sapele, where she was reunited with her family in a traumatised condition, with indications of sexual assault

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人于10月23日在Sapele的Ajimele地区被抓获
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: operatives acting on intelligence traced Ughagha to his hideout in the Ajimele area of Sapele, where he was arrested on October 23

key_facts.fact: 警方称嫌疑人初步审讯中已供认涉案
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: During preliminary interrogation, he reportedly confessed to his involvement in the crime

uncertainties: 绑架、性侵及认罪等情节均为警方指控与据称内容，尚未经法院审理证实
目前仅单一来源（Sahara Reporters）报道，缺乏交叉验证
性侵迹象有待医学检查结果确认
